Container.Name: music-assistant
Container.Overview: Music Assistant is a free, open source music library manager. It brings your streaming services and your own files together into one library, and plays them on almost any speaker in the house.
Container.Description: Music Assistant pulls your streaming services, local files, radio, podcasts, and audiobooks into a single searchable library. It streams to almost any player — Sonos, Chromecast, AirPlay, Squeezelite, DLNA, and others — with support for synchronized multi-room playback, gapless transitions, crossfade, and volume leveling. Music Assistant is a project of the Open Home Foundation.
